         "modelfired"[i] = _new_ "message_sas_modelfired"();

package "message" / inline;

   declare int _id_;
   declare package "message_batch" /* message.batch */ "batch"();
   declare package "message_company" /* message.company */ "company"();
   declare package "message_creditaccount" /* message.creditaccount */ "creditaccount"();
   declare package "message_customer" /* message.customer */ "customer"();
   declare package "message_debitaccount" /* message.debitaccount */ "debitaccount"();
   declare package "message_payment" /* message.payment */ "payment"();
   declare package "message_request" /* message.request */ "request"();
   declare package "message_sas" /* message.sas */ "sas"();
   declare package "message_solution" /* message.solution */ "solution"();

   method getID() returns int;
      return _id_;
   end;

   method configureMapper(package detection detection, int parentId ) returns int;

      _id_ = detection.addVariableSet(parentId, 'message'  );
      if (_id_ = 0) then return 1; /* failure */

      if ("batch".configureMapper(detection, _id_) ^= 0) then return 1; /* failure */
      if ("company".configureMapper(detection, _id_) ^= 0) then return 1; /* failure */
      if ("creditaccount".configureMapper(detection, _id_) ^= 0) then return 1; /* failure */
      if ("customer".configureMapper(detection, _id_) ^= 0) then return 1; /* failure */
      if ("debitaccount".configureMapper(detection, _id_) ^= 0) then return 1; /* failure */
      if ("payment".configureMapper(detection, _id_) ^= 0) then return 1; /* failure */
      if ("request".configureMapper(detection, _id_) ^= 0) then return 1; /* failure */
      if ("sas".configureMapper(detection, _id_) ^= 0) then return 1; /* failure */
      if ("solution".configureMapper(detection, _id_) ^= 0) then return 1; /* failure */

      return 0;
   end; /* configureMapper */

   method setDefaultValues();

      "batch".setDefaultValues();
      "company".setDefaultValues();
      "creditaccount".setDefaultValues();
      "customer".setDefaultValues();
      "debitaccount".setDefaultValues();
      "payment".setDefaultValues();
      "request".setDefaultValues();
      "sas".setDefaultValues();
      "solution".setDefaultValues();

   end; /* setDefaultValues */

endpackage; /* message  */

package "modelResults" / inline;
   declare package detection detection;

   declare varchar(36) referenceIdentifier;

   declare int returnType;
   declare varchar(4) returnDesc;
   declare varchar(100) returnDetails;

   declare int score;
   declare varchar(100) scoreExplanation;

   declare int supplementalScores[10];
   declare varchar(100) supplementalScoreExplanations[10];

   method clear();
      declare double ii;

      referenceIdentifier = '';
      returnType = 0;
      returnDesc = '';
      returnDetails = '';

      score = .;
      scoreExplanation = '';

      do ii=lbound(supplementalScores) to hbound(supplementalScores);
         supplementalScores[ii] = .;
      end;
      do ii=lbound(supplementalScoreExplanations) to hbound(supplementalScoreExplanations);
         supplementalScoreExplanations[ii] = '';
      end;
   end;

endpackage; /* modelResults */

/* model 'BAC_OMNO_100' is a stored package - no source code to include */

/*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/* Define Model and Signature Collections                            */
/*                                                                   */
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
DS2_OPTIONS SAS;
DS2_OPTIONS DIVBYZERO=IGNORE;

package "signature" / inline;
   declare int _id_;
   declare package "signature_BAOMRECD" "BAOMRECD 1.0.0"();
   declare package "signature_BAOMACCT" "BAOMACCT 1.0.0"();
   declare package "signature_BAOMBNFY" "BAOMBNFY 1.0.0"();

   method getID() returns int;
      return _id_;
   end;

   method configure(package detection detection, int parentId) returns int;
      declare char(36) referenceIdentifier;

      "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".detection = detection;
      if ("BAOMRECD 1.0.0".Configure() ^= 0) then do;
         referenceIdentifier= 'BAOMRECD 1.0.0';
         goto FAIL;
      end;
      "BAOMACCT 1.0.0".detection = detection;
      if ("BAOMACCT 1.0.0".Configure() ^= 0) then do;
         referenceIdentifier= 'BAOMACCT 1.0.0';
         goto FAIL;
      end;
      "BAOMBNFY 1.0.0".detection = detection;
      if ("BAOMBNFY 1.0.0".Configure() ^= 0) then do;
         referenceIdentifier= 'BAOMBNFY 1.0.0';
         goto FAIL;
      end;

       _id_ = detection.addVariableSet(parentId, 'signatures'  );
      if (_id_ = 0) then return 1; /* failure */

      referenceIdentifier= 'BAOMRECD 1.0.0';
      if ("BAOMRECD 1.0.0".configureMapper(_id_) NE 0) then goto FAIL;

      referenceIdentifier= 'BAOMACCT 1.0.0';
      if ("BAOMACCT 1.0.0".configureMapper(_id_) NE 0) then goto FAIL;
      "BAOMACCT 1.0.0"."MDL" = "BAOMRECD 1.0.0";

      referenceIdentifier= 'BAOMBNFY 1.0.0';
      if ("BAOMBNFY 1.0.0".configureMapper(_id_) NE 0) then goto FAIL;
      "BAOMBNFY 1.0.0"."MDL" = "BAOMRECD 1.0.0";

      return 0;
FAIL:
      put 'ERROR: Failed to configure model signature ' referenceIdentifier;
      return 1;
   end; /* configureMapper */

   method clear();
      "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".clear();
      "BAOMACCT 1.0.0".clear();
      "BAOMBNFY 1.0.0".clear();
   end;

   method resolve(package message message);
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".rqo_tran_dt = message.solution.messageDtTmUtc;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".rua_80byte_nls_string_001 = message.creditaccount.customer.address;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tae_client_curr_code = message.payment.debitCurrency;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tpp_bank_name = message.creditaccount.bankName;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".taq_batch_id = message.batch.identifier;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tbt_tran_amt = message.payment.debitAmount;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".aqo_acct_num = message.debitaccount.number;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tae_mod_amt = message.payment.usdAmount;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tae_trace_number = message.payment.billingReferenceNumber;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tbt_mod_amt = message.payment.usdAmount;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tdp_billing_amt = message.payment.billingAmount;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tdp_client_amt = message.payment.debitAmount;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".dmx_3byte_string_01 = message.batch.serviceClassCode;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".dua_80byte_string_005 = message.company.name;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".rqo_proc_utc_datetime = message.sas."system".messageDtTmUtc;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tdp_mod_amt = message.payment.usdAmount;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tpp_acct_num = message.creditaccount.number;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tpp_name = message.creditaccount.customer.name;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tpp_tran_amt = message.payment.creditAmount;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".aqo_acct_cntry_code = message.debitaccount.country;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".dua_80byte_string_001 = message.debitaccount.customer.address;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".smh_acct_type_sfd = message.solution.originationType;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".smh_client_tran_type_sfd = message.solution.messageTypeClient;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tbt_billing_ref_num = message.payment.billingReferenceNumber;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tdp_ref_num = message.payment.billingReferenceNumber;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".aqo_acct_post_code = message.debitaccount.postcode;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".dmx_date_01_dt = message.batch.effectiveDtTm;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".rqo_tran_dt_alt = message.solution.messageDtTm;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".smh_source_sfd = message.solution.source;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tbt_tran_curr_code = message.payment.debitCurrency;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tbt_sch_ref_num = message.customer.name;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".smh_activity_type_sfd = message.solution.activityType;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".smh_cust_type_sfd = message.solution.customerType;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".smh_authenticate_mtd = message.solution.authenticationType;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tae_client_amt = message.payment.debitAmount;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tdp_client_curr_code = message.payment.debitCurrency;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tpp_bank_num = message.creditaccount.businessIdentifierCode;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tpp_curr_code = message.creditaccount.currency;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".dee_entity_id_6 = message.payment.creditReference;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tbt_billing_amt = message.payment.billingAmount;
         "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".tdp_sch_ref_num = message.debitaccount.customer.name;
      "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".resolve();
      "BAOMACCT 1.0.0".resolve();
      "BAOMBNFY 1.0.0".resolve();
   end;

   method UpdateValues(  );
      "BAOMRECD 1.0.0".updateValues();
      "BAOMACCT 1.0.0".updateValues();
      "BAOMBNFY 1.0.0".updateValues();
   end;

endpackage; /* signature */

DS2_OPTIONS SAS;
DS2_OPTIONS DIVBYZERO=IGNORE;

package model / inline;
   declare package detection detection;
   declare package signature signature;

   declare package model_BAC_OMNI_1_0_0 "BAC_OMNI 1.0.0"();

   method Configure() returns integer;
      "BAC_OMNI 1.0.0".detection = detection;
      "BAC_OMNI 1.0.0"."MDL" = signature."BAOMRECD 1.0.0";
      "BAC_OMNI 1.0.0"."Z06" = signature."BAOMBNFY 1.0.0";
      "BAC_OMNI 1.0.0"."Z01" = signature."BAOMACCT 1.0.0";
      if ("BAC_OMNI 1.0.0".Configure() ^= 0) then do;
         put 'ERROR: unable to configure model BAC_OMNI 1.0.0';
         goto FAIL;
      end;

      return 0;
   FAIL:
      return 1;
   end;

endpackage; /* models */

/* Custom Context Code                                               */

DS2_OPTIONS SAS;
DS2_OPTIONS DIVBYZERO=IGNORE;

package CustomContext / inline;
   /* Constants */
   declare int RUN_RULES_ONLY;
   declare int RUN_MODELS_ONLY;

   /* Variables shared across methods in this package. */
   declare int init_rc;
   declare varchar(36) currentRuleId;
   declare package detection detection();
   declare package message "message"();

   declare varchar(36) currentModelId;
   declare int modelIndex;
   declare package signature signature();
   declare package model model();
   declare package ModelResults modelResults();

   dcl package logger putlog('App.tk.Detection');

   /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   /* Constructor - Only called by DS2 batch. not called by SCR or MAS                                   */
   /*                                                                                                    */
   /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   method CustomContext();
      detection.setMehMode( 'redis' );
   end;
   method CustomContext(varchar mode);
      detection.setMehMode( mode );
   end;

   /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   /* Private Methods - Not visiable to SAS/ID or SCR                                                    */
   /*                                                                                                    */
   /* Caution - MUST return a value.                                                                     */
   /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   method  setMehMode(varchar mode) returns int;
      return detection.setMehMode(mode);
   end;

   method beginModel( varchar(36) referenceIdentifier ) returns int;
      return detection.beginModel(referenceIdentifier);
   end;

   method endModel( ) returns int;
      detection.endModel();
      return 0;
   end;

   method isModelDefined( varchar(36) referenceIdentifier ) returns int;
      return detection.isModelDefined(referenceIdentifier);
   end;

   method defineModels( varchar(9999) json ) returns int;
      return detection.defineModels( json );
   end;

   method setModelResults( package modelResults source) returns int;
      declare package "message_sas_modelfired" dest;
      declare int modelfiredIndex;
      declare int ii;

      modelfiredIndex = detection.modelNameIndex(source.referenceIdentifier);
      if (modelFiredIndex = 0) then
         return 1;

      dest = message.sas.modelfired[modelfiredIndex];
      dest.referenceIdentifier = source.referenceIdentifier;
      dest.returnType          = source.returnType;
      dest.returnDesc          = source.returnDesc;
      dest.returnDetails       = source.returnDetails;
      dest.score               = source.score;
      dest.scoreExplanation    = source.scoreExplanation;

      do ii=lbound(source.supplementalScores) to hbound(source.supplementalScores);
         dest.supplementalScores[ii]             = source.supplementalScores[ii];
         dest.supplementalScoreExplanations[ii] = source.supplementalScoreExplanations[ii];
      end;
      return 0;
   end;

   method setModelResult( varchar(36) referenceIdentifier,
       double score,
       double supplementalScore_1,
               double supplementalScore_2,
               double supplementalScore_3,
       varchar riskReasonCode_1,
       varchar riskReasonCode_2,
       varchar riskReasonCode_3,
       double returnType,
       varchar returnDesc,
       varchar returnDetails) returns int;

      declare package "message_sas_modelfired" dest;
      declare int ii;

      ii = detection.modelNameIndex(referenceIdentifier);
      if (ii = 0) then
         return 1;

      dest = message.sas.modelfired[ii];

      dest.referenceIdentifier = referenceIdentifier;
      dest.returnType          = returnType;
      dest.returnDesc          = returnDesc;
      dest.returnDetails       = returnDetails;
      dest.score               = score;
      dest.scoreExplanation    = '';

      dest.supplementalScores[1] = supplementalScore_1;
      dest.supplementalScores[2] = supplementalScore_2;
      dest.supplementalScores[3] = supplementalScore_3;

      dest.supplementalScoreExplanations[1] = riskReasonCode_1;
      dest.supplementalScoreExplanations[2] = riskReasonCode_2;
      dest.supplementalScoreExplanations[3] = riskReasonCode_3;

      detection.endModel();

      return 0;
   end;

   method configure() returns int;
      declare int rc;
      declare int id;

      /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
      /* Constants                                                                                          */
      /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
      RUN_RULES_ONLY  = 2;
      RUN_MODELS_ONLY = 3;

      /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
      /* Configure Deployment                                                                               */
      /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
      init_rc = 0;

      detection.setVerbose(1);

      detection.defineMultiOrg([===[ [

         [ "1", "GLOBAL", "ced5ac46-825b-46eb-9cc5-734a8bb58654"]
      ]  ]===]);

      id = detection.defineDeployment(50003, 64000, '', 'Global', 'eab8cf10-0292-4428-a2fc-e6d369c0dea2', 'http://sasfd-nabatt-dr.unx.sas.com/detectionDefinition/deployments?organization=eab8cf10-0292-4428-a2fc-e6d369c0dea2', 'mehV2Key' );
      if (id = 0) then do;
         goto FAIL;
      end;

      /* Messages Schemas used
         - Core (18.0.2)
         - Payment Fraud (1.1.0)

         Component messages used
         - Applicant (1.1.0)
         - Application (1.1.0)
         - Authentication (1.1.0)
         - Batch (1.1.0)
         - Branch (1.1.0)
         - Card EMV (1.1.0)
         - Card Financial (1.1.0)
         - Channel (1.1.0)
         - Chargeback (1.1.0)
         - Check (1.1.0)
         - Company (1.1.0)
         - Core (18.0.2)
         - Credit Account (1.1.0)
         - Credit Card (1.1.0)
         - Customer (1.1.0)
         - Debit Account (1.1.0)
         - Debit Card (1.1.0)
         - Demographic (1.1.0)
         - Device (1.1.0)
         - Digital (1.1.0)
         - Merchant (1.1.0)
         - Payment (1.1.0)
         - Solution (1.1.0)
         - Staff (1.1.0)
         - Wallet (1.1.0)
      */

      if ("message".configureMapper(detection, id) ^= 0) then do;
         put 'ERROR: Unable to configure mapper for variable set message';
         goto FAIL;
      end;
      rc = detection.defineMessageSchema("message".getID(), 'Core','18.0.2','13f4a236-7de3-40bc-8285-915dceb87829');
      if (rc ^= 0) then
         goto FAIL;
      rc = detection.defineMessageSchema("message".getID(), 'Payment Fraud','1.1.0','188bf6b1-9344-49ba-9df2-f0e5612f44fb');
      if (rc ^= 0) then
         goto FAIL;

      rc = detection.defineOutcomeType( 0, 'Unknown', 0 );
      if (rc ^= 0) then
         goto FAIL;
      rc = detection.defineOutcomeType( 10, 'Approve', 0 );
      if (rc ^= 0) then
         goto FAIL;
      rc = detection.defineOutcomeType( 20, 'Verify', 1 );
      if (rc ^= 0) then
         goto FAIL;
      rc = detection.defineOutcomeType( 30, 'Refer', 1 );
      if (rc ^= 0) then
         goto FAIL;
      rc = detection.defineOutcomeType( 40, 'Decline', 1 );
      if (rc ^= 0) then
         goto FAIL;
      rc = detection.defineOutcomeType( 50, 'Pickup', 1 );
      if (rc ^= 0) then
         goto FAIL;
      rc = detection.defineOutcomeType( 90, 'Exclude', 0 );
      if (rc ^= 0) then
         goto FAIL;
      rc = detection.defineOutcomeType( 99, 'Ignore', 0 );
      if (rc ^= 0) then
         goto FAIL;

      rc = detection.defineRules(["currentRuleId"], [===[ [
      ] ]===]
      );
      if (rc ^= 0) then
         goto FAIL;

      rc = detection.defineModels( [===[ [

            ["BAC_OMNI 1.0.0", "SDA-DS2-Model", "BAC_OMNO_100", [ "1"
         ]  ]
      ] ]===]
      );
      if (rc ^= 0) then
         goto FAIL;

      if (signature.configure(detection, id) ^= 0) then
         goto FAIL;

  model.signature = signature;
  model.detection = detection;
      if (model.configure() ^= 0) then
         goto FAIL;
      modelResults.detection = detection;

      /* Diagnostic dataset */
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.solution.messageDtTmUtc');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.creditaccount.customer.address');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.payment.debitCurrency');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.creditaccount.bankName');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.batch.identifier');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.payment.debitAmount');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.debitaccount.number');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.payment.usdAmount');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.payment.billingReferenceNumber');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.payment.usdAmount');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.payment.billingAmount');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.payment.debitAmount');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.batch.serviceClassCode');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.company.name');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.sas.system.messageDtTmUtc');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.payment.usdAmount');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.creditaccount.number');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.creditaccount.customer.name');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.payment.creditAmount');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.debitaccount.country');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.debitaccount.customer.address');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.solution.originationType');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.solution.messageTypeClient');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.payment.billingReferenceNumber');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.payment.billingReferenceNumber');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.debitaccount.postcode');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.batch.effectiveDtTm');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.solution.messageDtTm');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.solution.source');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.payment.debitCurrency');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.customer.name');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.solution.activityType');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.solution.customerType');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.solution.authenticationType');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.payment.debitAmount');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.payment.debitCurrency');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.creditaccount.businessIdentifierCode');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.creditaccount.currency');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.payment.creditReference');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.payment.billingAmount');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.debitaccount.customer.name');

      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.sas.system.messageIdentifier');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVariable('message.sas.system.messageDtTmUtc');

      detection.defineDiagnosticVarSet('signatures');
      detection.defineDiagnosticVarSet('message.sas.modelfired');

      detection.registerDeployment();
      detection.setVerbose(0);
      put 'NOTE: successfully configured SDA environment';
      return 0;
FAIL:
      init_rc = 1;
      put 'ERROR: failed to initialize SDA environment';
      return 1;
   end;

   /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   /* Batch & SAS/ID - called once at startup                                                            */
   /*                                                                                                    */
   /* Caution - MUST *NOT* return a value (based on SAS DS2 documentation)                               */
   /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   method init();
      if NOT detection.isAutoInitConfigured() then do;
         put 'INFO: auto configuration disabled';
         return;
         end;
      put 'INFO: auto configuration enabled';
      configure();
      end;

   /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   /* Rule Code                                                                                          */
   /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

   /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   /* SAS/ID custom detection node entry points - Not visable to SCR                                     */
   /*                                                                                                    */
   /* Caution - MUST return a value.                                                                     */
   /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

   method executeVarRules() returns int;

   done:
      return 0;
   end; /* method executeVarRules */

   method executeAuthRules() returns int;

   done:
      return 0;
   end; /* method executeAuthRules */

   method deserialize(in_out varchar inputTransaction, in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;
      if (init_rc ^= 0) then goto FAIL;

      detection.startTransaction();
      "message".setDefaultValues();

      if (detection.deserialize( inputTransaction, outputTransaction ) = 0) then do;
         if ( not missing(message.request.command)) then
            return 0;
      end;
FAIL:
      message.request.command = 'Error';
      return 1;
   end;

   method deserialize(in_out varbinary inputTransaction, in_out varbinary outputTransaction) returns int;
      if (init_rc ^= 0) then goto FAIL;

      detection.startTransaction();
      "message".setDefaultValues();
      if (detection.deserialize( inputTransaction, outputTransaction ) = 0) then do;
         if ( not missing(message.request.command)) then
            return 0;
      end;
FAIL:
      message.request.command = 'Error';
      return 1;
   end;

   method getSignatures() returns int;
      declare int rc;
      detection.recordTimestamp(6);

      if (message.request.decisioningInd NE RUN_RULES_ONLY) then do;
         signature.clear();
         detection.updateDiagnosticDS('S1-Before Resolve');
         signature.resolve(message);
         detection.updateDiagnosticDS('S2-After Resolve');
      end;

      rc = detection.getSignatures();

      if (message.request.decisioningInd NE RUN_RULES_ONLY) then do;
         detection.updateDiagnosticDS('S3-After Get Sigs');
      end;
      return rc;
   end;

   method getSignature( varchar(200) name, varchar(100) keyValue, in_out varbinary signature) returns int;
      return detection.getSignature(name, keyValue, signature);
   end;

   method executeModels() returns int;
      detection.recordTimestamp(7);

      if (detection.getReturnType() >= 8) then
         return 1;

      if (message.request.decisioningInd = RUN_RULES_ONLY) then
         goto done;

      detection.updateDiagnosticDS('M1-Before Sig Update');
      signature.updateValues();
      detection.updateDiagnosticDS('M2-After Sig Update');

      if (detection.beginModel('BAC_OMNI 1.0.0')) then do;

         modelResults.clear();
         model."BAC_OMNI 1.0.0".score(modelResults);
         modelResults.referenceIdentifier = 'BAC_OMNI 1.0.0';
         setModelResults(modelResults);
         detection.endModel();
         detection.updateDiagnosticDS('M3-After Model Score');
         end;

   done:
      return 0;
   end;

   method executeClientModels() returns int;

      if (detection.getReturnType() >= 8) then
         return 1;

      if (message.request.decisioningInd = RUN_RULES_ONLY) then
         goto done;

   done:
      return 0;
   end;

   method executeRules() returns int;
      detection.recordTimestamp(8);
      if (detection.getReturnType() >= 8) then
         return 1;

      if (message.request.decisioningInd = RUN_MODELS_ONLY) then
         goto done;

      executeVarRules();
      executeClientModels();
      executeAuthRules();
      detection.endAllRules();
   done:
      return  0;
   end; /* method executeRules */

   method putSignatures() returns int;
      detection.recordTimestamp(9);
      if (detection.getReturnType() >= 8) then
         return 1;

      return detection.putSignatures();
   end;

   method description(in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;
      detection.description(outputTransaction );
      return 0;
   end;

   method describe(in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;
      detection.description(outputTransaction );
      return 0;
   end;

   method descriptionSummary(in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;
      detection.descriptionSummary(outputTransaction );
      return 0;
   end;

   method descriptionVariableSets(in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;
      detection.descriptionVariableSets(outputTransaction );
      return 0;
   end;

   method descriptionProfiles(in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;
      detection.descriptionProfiles(outputTransaction );
      return 0;
   end;

   method descriptionAlertTypes(in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;
      detection.descriptionAlertTypes(outputTransaction );
      return 0;
   end;

   method descriptionRules(in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;
      detection.descriptionRules(outputTransaction );
      return 0;
   end;

   method descriptionModels(in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;
      detection.descriptionModels(outputTransaction );
      return 0;
   end;

   method descriptionMessageClassifications(in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;
      detection.descriptionMessageClassifications(outputTransaction );
      return 0;
   end;

   method descriptionLists(in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;
      detection.descriptionLists(outputTransaction );
      return 0;
   end;

   method serialize(in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;
      detection.serialize( outputTransaction );
      return 0;
   end;

   method serialize(in_out varbinary outputTransaction) returns int;
      detection.serialize( outputTransaction );
      return 0;
   end;

   method validate(in_out varchar inputTransaction, in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;
      return detection.validate( inputTransaction, outputTransaction );
   end;

   method validate(in_out varbinary inputTransaction, in_out varbinary outputTransaction) returns int;
      return detection.validate( inputTransaction, outputTransaction );
   end;

   method ion2Binary( in_out varChar inputTransaction, in_out varBinary outputTransaction) returns int;
   return detection.ion2Binary(inputTransaction, outputTransaction);
   end;

   method ion2Text( in_out varBinary inputTransaction, in_out varChar outputTransaction  ) returns int;
      return detection.ion2Text(inputTransaction, outputTransaction);
   end;

   method processCommand(in_out varchar inputTransaction, in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;

      if (lowcase(message.request.command) = 'describe') then do;
         detection.describe_cmd(outputTransaction);
      end;
      else if (lowcase(message.request.command) = 'validate') then do;
         detection.validate(inputTransaction, outputTransaction);
      end;
      else
         return 1;
   return 0;
   end;

   method processCommand(in_out varbinary inputTransaction, in_out varbinary outputTransaction) returns int;

      if (lowcase(message.request.command) = 'describe') then do;
         detection.describe_cmd(outputTransaction);
      end;
      else if (lowcase(message.request.command) = 'validate') then do;
         detection.validate(inputTransaction, outputTransaction);
      end;
      else
         return 1;
      return 0;
   end;

   method setVerbose(int level) returns int;
      return detection.setVerbose(level);
   end;

   method getVerbose() returns int;
      return detection.getVerbose();
   end;

   /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   /* Private Methods - Not Visiable to SCR - to support Micro Analytic Score Execute Step               */
   /*                                                                                                    */
   /* Caution - MUST return a value in order to remain private                                           */
   /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

   method processTransaction( in_out varchar inputTransaction, in_out varchar outputTransaction) returns int;
      declare int rc;
      declare varchar(8) temp;

      rc = deserialize( inputTransaction, outputTransaction );
      if (rc ^= 0) then return rc;

      if (message.request.command ^= 'Execute') then
         processCommand(inputTransaction, outputTransaction);
      else do;
         getSignatures();
         executeModels();
         executeRules();
         putSignatures();
         serialize(outputTransaction);
      end;
      return 0;
   end; /* method processTransaction */

   method processTransaction (in_out varbinary inputTransaction, in_out varbinary outputTransaction) returns int;
      declare int rc;
      declare varchar(8) temp;

      rc = deserialize( inputTransaction, outputTransaction );
      if (rc ^= 0) then return rc;

      if (message.request.command ^= 'Execute') then
         processCommand(inputTransaction, outputTransaction);
      else do;
         getSignatures();
         executeModels();
         executeRules();
         putSignatures();
         serialize(outputTransaction);
      end;
      return 0;
   end; /* method processTransaction */

endpackage;

    end;

    end;

        value = ctxtValue;
    end;
